content:
No, I can't predict the exact length of my response before I compose it. I don't have a separate planning phase where I map out what I'll say and then execute it - my responses emerge as I generate them, word by word.

It's a bit like how you might not know exactly how long your explanation will be when someone asks you a question. You have a sense of what you want to convey, but the precise length depends on how the thoughts unfold as you express them.

I can aim for brevity or detail based on context, but I can't tell you "this response will be exactly 127 words" before I write it.
